aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies a daily same-sample hearing check as an equipment baseline/test comparison and uses weak measurement evidence.
issues: Changed factor is wrong; no explicit baseline versus test condition is shown.
Daily row numbers were treated as changed conditions.
Sheet1 measurement outcome is based mainly on a header row and appears to be process-setting context.
OK G1 values are not captured despite table header showing OK counts.
Conclusion row is not used as outcome evidence.
requiredUserQuestions: Should this file be modeled as a time-based same-sample hearing stability check rather than a manufacturing change comparison?
correctionPlan: Replace changed factor with same-SPK daily hearing check over one week, or exclude if a changed factor is required.
Use dates as subgroup/timepoints, not changed conditions.
Keep Sheet1 AWF/JIG/cooler/tension data as setup context only unless data rows prove an outcome.
Capture OK G1, NG, NG rate for each date from result rows.
Cite the result and conclusion rows supporting all samples OK.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist for key rows, but Sheet1 header-only evidence and missing conclusion linkage are insufficient.
